pt.Enter the File ID or the exact filename: Insira o ID do arquivo ou o nome exato do arquivo, dependendo da seleção "Analisar por"
The folder containing the file to copy. Leave empty to browse files in the root folder.
pt.The file to copy. If the file is not lis: The file to copy. If the file is not listed (up to 1000 files are fetched), toggle the dynamic input (F) and enter the file ID directly.
pt.The folder to copy the file into. Leave: The folder to copy the file into. Leave empty to copy it into the same folder as the source file.
pt.A new name for the copied file (e.g. rep: A new name for the copied file (e.g. report-copy.xlsx). If left empty, the original name is used.
pt.What to do if a file with the same name: What to do if a file with the same name already exists in the destination folder. Note: personal OneDrive (consumer) accounts do not support this option and may fail on name conflicts regardless of the selection.
